items.name: magic-modal
items.title: Magic Modal Dialog
items.description: A typed Expo and React Native dialog surface with accessible semantics and backdrop cancellation.
items.author: Gabriel Taveira <gabrielstaveira@gmail.com>
items.docs: Mount MagicModalPortal once after your app content and inside GestureHandlerRootView. Expo projects should install the native peers with `npx expo install react-native-gesture-handler react-native-reanimated react-native-worklets react-native-screens`. A backdrop press resolves the returned promise with MagicModalHideReason.BACKDROP_PRESS.
